text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote states the primary goal of the DEI is a 40% digital viewership increase within the first year of launch, from the Project Overview."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote lists the mobile app (iOS and Android), web streaming portal, and third-party smart TV integration as the initiative's covered platforms."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Project Overview Key Details lists Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Budget & Timeline Breakdown states the Finance Committee's December 2026 revision adjusted the total budget to $2,600,000."},{"claim_index":4,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Project Overview Key Details lists Planned Launch Date: March 15, 2027."},{"claim_index":5,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Team & Governance Document says the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027."},{"claim_index":6,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Budget & Timeline Breakdown timeline table lists Public launch as March 15, 2027."},{"claim_index":7,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Table allocates by quarter across development, marketing, operations, with Q1 total $630,000 and Q2 total $720,000."},{"claim_index":8,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote states the steering committee meets bi-weekly to review project status, budget utilization, and risk items."},{"claim_index":9,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote states budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation."},{"claim_index":10,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Overview names Sara Al-Rashid as Project Lead; governance document says budget/scope changes are escalated to the Project Lead who brings them to the steering committee."},{"claim_index":11,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Neutral label asserting no fact."},{"claim_index":12,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Neutral label asserting no fact."}]}
